INTERTEXTUALITY IN THE PRESENTATION OF THE THEME OF VIOLENCE IN THE NOVEL MSICHANA WA MBALAMWEZI BY K.W. WAMITILA. Authors of the modern Swahili novel convey messages to the audience by focusing on experimental literary techniques. Intertextuality is one of the key elements of those experimental techniques. The novels themselves have been called “experimental novels” or “modern novels.” Other experts have classified them as “Twenty-First Century novels.” The author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila is one of the modern writers who employs this new writing style to address various issues affecting society. The theory of postmodernism has guided this research in the analysis of the aspect of intertextuality. Various types of texts referenced in the presentation of the theme of violence were identified and explained. The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi was deliberately selected because it is presented through numerous short narratives that reference different texts. The descriptive content analysis method was used to analyze the data related to the overall issue of intertextuality. The data was analyzed by focusing on themes, settings, and key elements of experimental writing techniques. The findings were presented descriptively. It was revealed that a lack of order in the conduct of affairs is the true reflection of today's society. The referenced texts have shown that the ordinary citizen has been oppressed and provided with poor services by the leaders. This article has examined and evaluated how the author uses the technique of intertextuality as a device for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Janice M. Introduction:- 1.1 Introduction This article addresses the issue of intertextuality as a tool for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi (2011) by Kyallo Wadi Wamitila. The main objective is to identify the various types of texts referenced in the effort to present the theme of oppression. Regarding these matters, the article has demonstrated how the modern Swahili novel portrays a comprehensive image of today's society. This has been discussed within the framework of modern literary theory. Address:–Egerton University, Kenya. 1.2 Summary of the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi The main character in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is Yosi Kanga. He has had a good job and a good life. One day, things changed for her soon after she celebrated her thirty-fifth birthday. Yosi Kanga left the office at one o’clock for the afternoon break. She lay down in the garden, and soon sleep carried her away. He had a dream in which he was in danger. In that dream, a certain girl whom he knew as the msichana wa mbalamwezi saved him. He went to get lunch at a hotel near the headquarters of the Kenya Railways Corporation. After lunch, he suddenly collapses and falls ill. He was taken to City Breeze Hospital and admitted there. The doctor said that Yosi Kanga had a tumor in his head and, because of that, he had a short time to live. The services in the hospital were not good. The doctors and some of the staff mistreated the patients. Many of those patients died in ways that were not understood. Later, a female doctor visited her. The moment he saw her, Yosi was overcome by a certain feeling. He tried to remember where he had seen that doctor before. The doctor checked on his condition and after a brief conversation decided to break the news to him. Examinations and all ECG scan reports showed that Yosi was in good health. The doctor instructed him to prepare to leave the hospital. Yosi was very happy because the “death sentence” he had been given in the hospital was revoked. So this was his savior, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Modernism  
The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is written on the foundations of modernism. The main element of modernism is the violation of realist writing conventions. Instead of adhering to the realist framework, the author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, as a modern writer, has written this novel based on new realism. Rettova (2016) has described Wamitila as a writer who leans towards modernism because he values the use of experimental techniques. Intertextuality is a key element in the perspective of modernist writing. Scholars have noted that it is difficult to draw boundaries between modernity and modernism. Modernity refers to a period in the history of literature that was closely tied to changes in the arts, especially between the 1880s and 1930s in Europe. At that time, human beings demonstrated their ability and power to create, strengthen, and shape their environment through new scientific, technological, and experimental methods (Best et al., 2001). These changes arose from the fact that, in the past, literature was dominated by religion and politics. The artistic changes involved literary genres such as poetry, drama, novels, dance, and film. Core themes, authentic language, realism, and a coherent structure are the key aspects that have been emphasized. European cities that witnessed these changes include Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, and Moscow. These changes were called Modernity and were the core and foundation of modernism. Abrams (1993) maintains that modernity is used to describe and identify new features of themes, genres, concepts, and literary styles associated with the first decades of the twentieth century, that is, after the Second World War. Abrams further emphasizes that the characteristics referred to vary depending on the critics involved. Wamitila (2007) states, “Despite these differences, most critics agree that the foundation of these features is a departure from the traditional foundations of art and Western or pre-existing culture.” According to this, it is evident that modernity completely broke away from the conventions of literary composition that were followed before the twentieth century. Although the exact time of the emergence of modernity and modernism is a matter of debate, it is clear that modernism arose and was built on the foundations of modernity. Modernism emerged and was established in the twentieth century. It was associated with Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, among others. Other scholars who have contributed to the theory of modernism include Jurgen Habermas (1987), who emphasizes that the contemporary world relies more on aspects of modernism, in which all activities related to modern human beings are examined through multiple narratives. A recent interpreter of this theory is Fredric Jameson (1991). This article focuses on various views of the theory as established by Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), and others. Lyotard (1984) maintains the controversial theory that the consciousness of members of society has been greatly transformed by the changes brought about by the industrial development period. This situation has led society to change its cultures and embrace modernist cultures. The modernist period disrupted the boundaries established by traditional culture. This phenomenon has manifested in various aspects of society, including literature. Life and people are not orderly, and therefore literary works should not have any particular order. Modernism is closely associated with popular culture, where people do things in whatever way they wish without following traditional norms. The writer gives himself permission to use another artist’s work to create a new one. With regard to these issues, this article has identified the types of texts referenced by the author K.W. Wamitila in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi to present the theme of oppression. Furthermore, it has analyzed how these texts were used in conveying the theme of oppression. This research focused on the aspect of intertextuality. Carter (2006) explains that modernism violates all conventions and rules of composition. The rules Carter refers to may be structural or linguistic. This is to say that, along with popular literature, modernism is also associated with popular performance. One well-known feature in popular literature is the “stream of consciousness,” which is a narrative technique in prose writing that employs lengthy descriptions focusing on the thoughts passing through a character’s mind (Wamitila, 2006). This performance takes place anywhere and does not follow any particular order. Often, the writer’s main goal is simply to entertain society. Popular performance uses popular language. Since language is an important tool in literary writing, modernism focuses on the use of language in a very free manner without adhering to its fluency or standardization. It also involves mixing different languages, for example, English and Swahili or first languages and Swahili. This concept guided this research in analyzing specific issues concerning the use of popular language, especially code-mixing and code-switching in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. The language used refers to various texts that present the theme of oppression in society. The foundation of modernism was employed to guide the research in the analysis of intertextuality as one of the key elements of experimental novels. The researcher has identified how this element disrupts order in the selected novel. 1.4 Intertextuality

Intertextuality is the translation of the English term “intertextuality,” which was first used by the French philosopher Julia Kristeva in her book ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). According to Kristeva, every word is a reference to other words. Thus, emphasis is placed on the idea that texts are related to and depend on one another to create meaning. Stam (2000), as quoted in Anderson (2004:1), states, “Any emerging text must inevitably coexist with another, or with other texts with which the original has also coexisted.” This statement demonstrates that a literary work does not originate solely from the mind of the author or from a vacuum, but is instead a collection of different texts. (Anderson, 2004) claims that intertextuality involves “that which has already been said.” Intertextuality is an important element of modernism, in which Wamitila writes. In addition, intertextuality is one of the key elements of experimental writing. The intertextuality that frequently appears in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is characterized by the use of short stories, branches of oral literature, philosophical opinions, poetry/songs, and language mixing. All these texts have been used in this novel to present the theme of oppression in various spheres of society such as health, education, and love. All these aspects interact and depend on each other in developing the creativity of the author. According to Julia Kristeva (1980), a text is related to other texts. This article has established that in presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, various texts are interconnected, interact, and depend on each other. Jilala (2016) explains that the meaning of one text is derived from other texts. In literature, meaning is represented by themes (Mohammed, 1995). Intertextuality in the selected novel has manifested at various levels such as form, characterization, motif, and themes. This article has identified the types of texts referenced in presenting the theme of oppression. Enani (2005) asserts that intertextuality influences the way a new text is read. The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi has demonstrated the presence of stylistic intermingling. Many of the references in this novel are of different styles and have influenced the narrative structure and plot. The audience is taken here and there. The reader starts reading one segment of the story, and before finishing it, another begins. This phenomenon results in complexity within the story itself. Wamitila (2010) asserts that this type of reference can lead to either negative or positive outcomes. Bakhtin (1981:271) argues that what is said is more than just the utterances themselves. Different contexts affect literary works in various ways. Contexts such as economic, social, or political factors influence certain relationships within literary works (Wamitila, 2010). Accordingly, this article has analyzed and critiqued the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, identifying the different types of contexts referenced, their relationships, and how those relationships contribute to presenting the theme of oppression. 1.5 Intertextual References and the Presentation of the Theme of Oppression in the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: A Modernist Perspective

Developing countries oppress their citizens in various ways. These methods are especially apparent in the manner in which services are delivered. For various reasons, which artists themselves may possess, such oppression is creatively presented through literature. To fully express this situation, narrative techniques and literary devices are employed with skill and artistry. The author K.W. Wamitila has used the element of intertextuality to illustrate the decay and oppression present in his society. This article has demonstrated how "ordinary" citizens are tormented by life in their country due to being deprived of essential services. This section has thoroughly explained the types of texts referenced by the author in his communication with society concerning oppression. 1.5.1 Philosophical Texts According to Lyotard (1997), postmodernism is based on the application of philosophical ideas in composition. Internal pressures and challenges are best understood when related to a particular philosophy or body of scholarship. However, philosophical texts can be complex for readers (Mwamzandi, 2013). The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is dominated by short narratives that refer to the opinions of philosophers. The philosophy of existentialism has led the author to accept that the oppression he experiences in the hospital is just one step in the journey toward his ultimate fate, which is death. The environment of the hospital where Yosi Kanga, the main character in this novel, was admitted was deplorable. The author notes that the beds were old. He describes this situation by saying, “…the metal frames were worn and had started to show patches of rust here and there, the thin sisal mattress was covered with a sheet that had lost its color and resembled a garment soaked in water, leaving stains all over.” (MWM. Ok. 25). The patient referred to had already been told by the doctor that they had a short time to live. Basically, even a patient in a critical condition needs to be given their human rights. The situation in the hospital disheartens him even more. This is because it oppresses him and denies him the right to quality care, even though he knew his fate was death. Moreover, he is oppressed emotionally to the point where he consoles himself with existential thoughts: “…I will rest when I am dead after a few days, and as our people say, the numbered days are few—they pass in the blink of an eye.” (MWM. p.48). According to Diegner (2005), the philosophy of existentialism holds that the ultimate fate of human beings is death. It does not matter whether she has a good job or not. Aside from having a good job that covered her medical expenses, the only solution for Yosi Kanga was death. 1.5.2. Religious texts (the Christian religion, indigenous religions) indicate that Yosi Kanga had health problems since the past which were caused by childhood accidents. Whenever she faced a problem, she was taken to the hospital on a stretcher with a wheel that made a lot of noise. Every time the neighbor's children heard the noise of that stretcher’s wheel, they knew Yosi was being taken to the hospital. Those children stood near the wire fence of their fruit farm and made mocking and derisive gestures at him. The author says, “I wished I had the power of the Biblical David. I would climb onto that cart, look for a wild tunguja fruit or perhaps even a pebble, and strike them on their foreheads to silence their Goliath” (MWM). Page. 21). Yosi saw the neighborhood children as the Goliath of the Bible, who oppressed and mocked the children of Israel. According to the Christian religion, Goliath's oppression of the Israelites was ended by a young boy, David, who slung a stone and killed him. Yosi wished that if he had the strength of David, he would silence those children who laughed at him and belittled him. Moreover, he likens their laughter to Goliath. Earlier, the character Konzi owned a hotel where he worked together with his wife. The author explains that Konzi used to mistreat women, but this habit ended when he got married. However, he continued to offend his wife by desiring other women who came to the hotel, right before his wife’s eyes. Konzi’s wife, whose name is Tabitha, views this behavior as disobedience to the Creator. The one being referred to as the Creator is Almighty God. For Tabitha, such abuse is an act of disobedience to one of the Ten Commandments of God, which warns against adultery as recorded in the Bible (Exodus 20). Tabitha retaliated against her husband by abusing him even more. The author says that Tabitha burst into loud laughter, turning this way and that as if seeking the companionship of others. Finally, she asked her husband whether he really knew her well. Tabitha ended by saying, “If you’re a snake, then I’m the master at drawing out its poison!” (MWM. p.51). The text referred to in this narrative is superstitious. The author Wamitila explains that after this strange event, Mr. Konzi was unable to pass stool or urinate. He was unable to reach the hotel again, “to see those women with faces like tomatoes or to spread butter on their bread” (MWM. Okay. 51). It is evident that his wife used witchcraft to bewitch her husband in an attempt to control him because of "external influences." Moreover, when Konzi was taken to Machakos General Hospital, the doctors were unable to help him. The writer says that even X-ray images did not show any problem. When his abdomen was examined with a stethoscope, the sound heard resembled a rooster crowing. He was advised by the doctor to return home, where his wife laughed and scolded him. Later, she gave him a light slap on the cheek, and the problem of the lump disappeared. It has been revealed that Tabitha used supernatural powers to punish anyone who disrespected her, especially her husband, Konzi. When a community lacks appropriate mechanisms for ensuring justice, it seeks its own means. In this context, the method used by Tabitha disrupts order and morality within the community. Normally, a wife takes care of and respects her husband in every way. 1.5.3 Academic Texts The doctor told the character Yosi Kanga that the health problem he was experiencing was caused by a swelling on his head. He went on to mention that he did not have many days left to live. The author uses the following words to describe this situation: “It seems… hmm… he has a problem of brain tumour… or even intracranial hypertension…! If my diagnosis is correct, because I have never been wrong in all my years of medical practice, he has about twenty-eight days to live… in fact it might even be less!” Academic texts have been used to torment Yosi mentally and emotionally. The examination was not conducted properly because it is later revealed that Yosi was in good health. The doctor boasted of being a scholar who had studied medicine at renowned institutions, “an alumnus of prestigious universities” (MWM). Yes. 31). Thus, when he spoke about his patient’s condition, Joseph knew and believed the truth that his days on earth had come to an end. 1.5.4 Political Texts  
The political situation often oppresses members of society. It has been observed that in many developing countries, politicians use young people to advance their own interests. The author of the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi narrates a story concerning soldiers. He explains that their faces reminded him of the “gangs of men” used by the wealthy to threaten their debtors (MWM). Page. 106). Similarly, the author narrates about the character Moylee Gaga, who bought a house in the Golden Gate neighborhood at an auction after the homeowner failed to pay his mortgage while still living inside. The homeowner needed to move out of the house that had gotten a new owner. The person who bought it did not know how to evict the occupant, so Moylee Gaga was advised to find a gang of youths, as politicians do, give them money to buy alcohol on Madongokuinama Street, then have them go there at night and throw out the homeowner’s belongings, regardless of the crying and shouting from his family (MWM). Uk. 106 – 107). Here, even though the homeowner failed to pay the mortgage, their eviction was carried out in a manner that was unjust and abusive. Another political term that was used is the word “operation” (MWM). Op. 107). This word illustrates how society suffers at the hands of those who are expected to protect it. Moylee Gaga is further advised, "just make sure that the chief of police in that area is aware—I think you understand me—that you simply have a certain 'operation'; as long as he knows, then you have absolutely nothing to fear." Everything will go smoothly. Political language is evident in the words and actions of the various actors mentioned in this context. Njogu (1987) found in his study that the lower class (those living in Madongokuinama) constantly fight against the elite. Contrary to this study, the oppressed appear to accept their situation. Moreover, they accept being “used” by the elite in exchange for small items such as alcohol. Those in power abuse their authority to harm others who are in the lower class. Extreme oppression is when the writer says that it is enough for the police chief to simply know about a certain “operation.” This is contrary to the expectations of the community. This is consistent with Kamunde’s (1983) observation that members of the lower class are oppressed by those of the upper class, although they eventually become aware of this and fight for their rights. 1.6 Conclusion  
This article has established that meaning, values, and truth are attained without relying on a single method or perspective, because their true source is society. Oppression in society has been presented through the use of intertextuality, which is an aspect of experimental writing. Various texts, including those of a philosophical, religious, academic, and political nature, have been used to convey the theme of oppression in the novel *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*. The author has used short narratives with specific intertextual references to illustrate how members of the community are denied their rights. Similarly, it has become evident that the lack of order in modern life is reflected in modern literature. However, although the disorder in carrying out various activities may appear inadequate, it is sufficient in literature. This inadequacy is in fact a true representation of modern life, that is, a complete image of today’s society. The current Swahili novel is appropriate because it serves as a true reflection of today’s society. It has become evident that short narratives referring to different texts are effective in presenting themes, rather than using a single long story written in the style of realism. Any creator has the freedom to try new methods in carrying out their work without being restricted or fixated on traditional rules. Therefore, a writer of literary works has the freedom to experiment with new approaches to writing without being constrained by traditional techniques that are rooted in realism. However, there is a risk that reading and understanding the modern novel requires prior knowledge of many issues related to philosophy, various disciplines, religion, politics, popular language, and others. Siku moja, mambo yalibadilika kwa ajili yake muda mfupi baada ya yeye kusherehekea siku yake ya kuzaliwa ya miaka 35. Yosi Kanga aliondoka ofisini saa moja kwa mapumziko ya mchana. Alikaa katika bustani, na punde tu usingizi ulimchukua. Katika ndoto hiyo, msichana fulani ambaye alimjua kama msichana wa mbalamwezi alimwokoa. Alienda kula chakula cha mchana katika hoteli moja karibu na makao makuu ya Shirika la Reli la Kenya. Baada ya chakula cha mchana, anazimia ghafula na kuwa mgonjwa. Alipelekwa kwenye Hospitali ya City Breeze na kulazwa huko. Daktari alisema kwamba Yosi Kanga alikuwa na uvimbe kichwani mwake na, kwa sababu hiyo, alikuwa na muda mfupi wa kuishi. Huduma katika hospitali hiyo hazikuwa nzuri. Madaktari na baadhi ya wafanyakazi waliwatendea vibaya wagonjwa. Wagonjwa wengi walikufa kwa njia ambazo hazikueleweka. Baadaye, daktari mmoja wa kike alimtembelea. Yosi alipokutana na daktari huyo, alipata hisia fulani, na akajaribu kukumbuka mahali ambapo alikuwa amemwona daktari huyo. Daktari huyo alichunguza hali yake na baada ya mazungumzo mafupi akaamua kumjulisha habari hizo. Uchunguzi na ripoti zote za eksirei ya ECG zilionyesha kwamba Yosi alikuwa na afya nzuri. Daktari alimwambia Yosi ajitayarishe kuondoka hospitalini, na Yosi alifurahi sana kwa sababu "hukumu ya kifo" aliyopewa hospitalini ilifutwa. Kwa hiyo huyu alikuwa mwokozi wake, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. 1.3 Kisasa Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeandikwa juu ya misingi ya kisasa. Kipengele kikuu cha kisasa ni ukiukaji wa mikataba ya uandishi wa kweli. Badala ya kushikamana na mfumo wa uhalisi, mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, kama mwandishi wa kisasa, ameandika riwaya hii kulingana na uhalisi mpya. Rettova (2016) ameelezea Wamitila kama mwandishi ambaye anaelekea kwa kisasa kwa sababu anathamini matumizi ya mbinu za majaribio. Intertextuality ni kipengele muhimu katika mtazamo wa maandishi ya kisasa. Wasomi wamegundua kuwa ni vigumu kuchora mipaka kati ya kisasa na kisasa. kisasa inahusu kipindi katika historia ya fasihi ambayo ilikuwa karibu kushikamana na mabadiliko katika sanaa, hasa kati ya 1880 na 1930 katika Ulaya. Wakati huo, wanadamu walionyesha uwezo na nguvu zao za kuunda, kuimarisha, na kuunda mazingira yao kupitia mbinu mpya za kisayansi, kiteknolojia, na majaribio (Best et al., 2001). Mabadiliko haya yalitokana na ukweli kwamba, zamani, fasihi ilitawaliwa na dini na siasa. Mabadiliko ya kisanii yalihusisha aina za fasihi kama vile mashairi, mchezo wa kuigiza, riwaya, densi, na filamu. Mandhari ya msingi, lugha halisi, uhalisi, na muundo thabiti ni mambo muhimu ambayo yamesisitizwa. Miji ya Ulaya iliyoona mabadiliko hayo ni pamoja na Paris, Vienna, Roma, London, na Moscow. Mabadiliko hayo yaliitwa Utamaduni na yalikuwa msingi na msingi wa kisasa. Abrams (1993) anasisitiza kuwa kisasa hutumiwa kuelezea na kutambua sifa mpya za mada, aina, dhana, na mitindo ya fasihi inayohusishwa na miongo ya kwanza ya karne ya ishirini, yaani, baada ya Vita vya Pili vya Ulimwengu. Abrams zaidi anasisitiza kwamba sifa zinazotajwa hutofautiana kulingana na wakosoaji waliohusika. Wamitila (2007) anasema, Licha ya tofauti hizi, wakosoaji wengi wanakubaliana kwamba msingi wa sifa hizi ni kuondoka kwa misingi ya jadi ya sanaa na utamaduni wa Magharibi au uliopo. Kulingana na hili, ni dhahiri kwamba kisasa kabisa kuvunja mbali na mikataba ya usanifu wa fasihi ambayo walikuwa ikifuatiwa kabla ya karne ya ishirini. Ingawa wakati halisi wa kuibuka ya kisasa na modernism ni suala la mjadala, ni wazi kwamba modernism iliibuka na ilijengwa juu ya misingi ya kisasa. kisasa iliibuka na ilianzishwa katika karne ya ishirini. Ilihusishwa na Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, miongoni mwa wengine. Wasomi wengine ambao wamechangia nadharia ya kisasa ni pamoja na Jurgen Habermas (1987), ambaye anasisitiza kwamba ulimwengu wa kisasa unategemea zaidi juu ya mambo ya kisasa, ambayo shughuli zote zinazohusiana na wanadamu wa kisasa huchunguzwa kupitia hadithi nyingi. Mfasiri wa hivi karibuni wa nadharia hii ni Fredric Jameson (1991). Makala hii inazingatia maoni mbalimbali ya nadharia kama ilivyopangwa na Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), na wengine. Lyotard (1984) anashikilia nadharia ya utata kwamba fahamu ya wanajamii imebadilishwa sana na mabadiliko yaliyoletwa na kipindi cha maendeleo ya viwanda. Hali hii imesababisha jamii kubadilisha tamaduni zake na kukumbatia tamaduni za kisasa. Kipindi cha kisasa kilivunja mipaka iliyowekwa na utamaduni wa jadi. Hali hii imeonekana katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii, ikiwa ni pamoja na fasihi. Maisha na watu si ya utaratibu, na kwa hiyo kazi za fasihi hazipaswi kuwa na utaratibu wowote maalum. Mwandishi anajipa ruhusa ya kutumia kazi ya msanii mwingine kuunda mpya. Kuhusiana na masuala haya, makala hii imebaini aina ya maandishi yaliyotajwa na mwandishi K.W. Wamitila katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ili kuwasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji. Zaidi ya hayo, imechambua jinsi maandishi haya yalivyotumika katika kuwasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji. Utafiti huu ulilenga kipengele cha intertextuality. Carter (2006) anaelezea kwamba kisasa kukiuka mikataba yote na sheria ya utungaji. sheria Carter inahusu inaweza kuwa ya kimuundo au lugha. Hii ni kusema kwamba, pamoja na fasihi maarufu, modernism pia inahusishwa na utendaji maarufu. Moja ya sifa inayojulikana katika fasihi maarufu ni "mtiririko wa fahamu", ambayo ni mbinu ya hadithi katika prose kuandika ambayo inajumuisha maelezo marefu kuzingatia mawazo kupita kwa njia ya akili ya tabia (Wamitila, 2006). Maonyesho haya hufanyika mahali popote na hayafuati utaratibu wowote maalum. Mara nyingi, lengo kuu la mwandishi ni tu kuburudisha jamii. Maonyesho ya watu wengi hutumia lugha ya watu wengi. Kwa kuwa lugha ni kifaa muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi, kisasa huzingatia matumizi ya lugha kwa njia ya bure sana bila kuzingatia ufasaha wake au uhalali. Pia inahusisha kuchanganya lugha tofauti, kwa mfano, Kiingereza na Kiswahili au lugha za kwanza na Kiswahili. Dhana hii iliongoza utafiti huu katika kuchambua maswala maalum yanayohusu matumizi ya lugha maarufu, haswa kuchanganya nambari na kubadilisha nambari katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Lugha inayotumika inahusu maandishi anuwai ambayo yanawasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji katika jamii. Msingi wa kisasa ulitumika kuongoza utafiti katika uchambuzi wa uingiliano wa maandishi kama moja ya mambo muhimu ya riwaya za majaribio. Mtafiti amebainisha jinsi kipengele hiki kinavuruga utaratibu katika riwaya iliyochaguliwa. 1.4 Intertextuality Intertextuality ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza intertextuality, ambalo lilitumiwa kwanza na mwanafalsafa wa Kifaransa Julia Kristeva katika kitabu chake Dialogue and Novel (1966). Kulingana na Kristeva, kila neno ni rejea kwa maneno mengine. Kwa hivyo, msisitizo unawekwa kwenye wazo kwamba maandishi yanahusiana na hutegemea kila mmoja kuunda maana. Stam (2000), kama ilivyonukuliwa katika Anderson (2004:1), inasema, "Maandishi yoyote yanayotokea lazima kwa lazima yaishi pamoja na mengine, au na maandishi mengine ambayo asili pia imeishi pamoja. " Taarifa hii inaonyesha kwamba kazi ya fasihi haitoi tu kutoka kwa akili ya mwandishi au kutoka kwa utupu, lakini badala yake ni mkusanyiko wa maandishi tofauti. (Anderson, 2004) anadai kwamba intertextuality inahusisha  kile ambacho tayari imesemwa. Intertextuality ni kipengele muhimu cha kisasa, ambayo Wamitila anaandika. Kwa kuongezea, kuingiliana kwa maandishi ni moja ya mambo muhimu ya uandishi wa majaribio. Kuingiliana kwa maandishi ambayo mara nyingi huonekana katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ina sifa ya matumizi ya hadithi fupi, matawi ya fasihi ya mdomo, maoni ya falsafa, mashairi / nyimbo, na kuchanganya lugha. Nakala hizi zote zimetumika katika riwaya hii kuwasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji katika nyanja anuwai za jamii kama vile afya, elimu, na upendo. Vitu hivi vyote vinaingiliana na kutegemea kila mmoja katika kukuza ubunifu wa mwandishi. Kulingana na Julia Kristeva (1980), maandishi yanahusiana na maandishi mengine. Makala hii imeonyesha kwamba katika kuelezea mada ya ukandamizaji katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, maandishi mbalimbali yanaunganishwa, yanaingiliana, na kutegemeana. Jilala (2016) anaelezea kwamba maana ya maandishi moja inatokana na maandishi mengine. Katika fasihi, maana inawakilishwa na mandhari (Mohammed, 1995). Intertextuality katika riwaya iliyochaguliwa imeonekana katika ngazi anuwai kama vile fomu, tabia, motif, na mandhari. Makala hii imebainisha aina ya maandishi yaliyotajwa katika kuwasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji. Enani (2005) anadai kwamba intertextuality huathiri njia ambayo maandishi mapya yanasomwa. Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeonyesha uwepo wa kuchanganyikiwa kwa mtindo. Marejeleo mengi katika riwaya hii ni ya mitindo tofauti na yameathiri muundo wa hadithi na njama. Wasikilizaji hupelekwa hapa na pale. Msomaji huanza kusoma sehemu moja ya hadithi, na kabla ya kuimaliza, nyingine huanza. Hali hii husababisha ugumu ndani ya hadithi yenyewe. Wamitila (2010) anadai kwamba aina hii ya kumbukumbu inaweza kusababisha matokeo hasi au chanya. Bakhtin (1981:271) anasema kwamba kile kinachosemwa ni zaidi ya maneno yenyewe. Mazingira tofauti huathiri kazi za fasihi kwa njia tofauti. Mazingira kama vile sababu za kiuchumi, kijamii, au kisiasa huathiri uhusiano fulani ndani ya kazi za fasihi (Wamitila, 2010). Kwa hiyo, makala hii imechambua na kukosoa riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, ikibainisha aina tofauti za muktadha unaorejelewa, mahusiano yao, na jinsi mahusiano hayo yanavyosaidia katika kuwasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji. 1.5 Marejeleo ya kati ya maandishi na Uwasilishaji wa Mada ya Ukandamizaji katika Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: Mtazamo wa Kisasa Nchi zinazoendelea zinawakandamiza raia wao kwa njia mbalimbali. Mbinu hizi zinaonekana hasa katika njia ambazo huduma hutolewa. Kwa sababu mbalimbali, ambazo wasanii wenyewe wanaweza kuwa nazo, ukandamizaji kama huo unawasilishwa kwa ubunifu kupitia fasihi. Ili kuelezea kikamilifu hali hii, mbinu za hadithi na vifaa vya fasihi hutumiwa kwa ustadi na sanaa. Mwandishi KW Wamitila ametumia kipengele cha intertextuality kuelezea uharibifu na ukandamizaji uliopo katika jamii yake. Makala hii imeonyesha jinsi wananchi "wa kawaida" wanavyoteseka kutokana na maisha katika nchi yao kwa sababu ya kupoteza huduma muhimu. Sehemu hii imeelezea kikamilifu aina ya maandishi ambayo mwandishi ametaja katika mawasiliano yake na jamii kuhusu ukandamizaji. 1.5.1 Maandishi ya Falsafa Kulingana na Lyotard (1997), postmodernism inategemea matumizi ya mawazo ya falsafa katika muundo. Shinikizo na changamoto za ndani zinaeleweka vizuri wakati zinahusiana na falsafa fulani au mwili wa udhamini. Walakini, maandishi ya falsafa yanaweza kuwa ngumu kwa wasomaji (Mwamzandi, 2013). Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ina hadithi fupi ambazo zinataja maoni ya wanafalsafa. Falsafa ya uwepo imemfanya mwandishi kukubali kwamba ukandamizaji anaoupitia hospitalini ni hatua moja tu katika safari ya kuelekea hatima yake ya mwisho, ambayo ni kifo. Mazingira ya hospitali ambapo Yosi Kanga, mhusika mkuu katika riwaya hii, alilazwa yalikuwa mabaya. Mwandishi anabainisha kuwa vitanda vilikuwa vya zamani. Anaelezea hali hii kwa kusema,  ... muafaka wa chuma ulikuwa umevaa na ulikuwa umeanza kuonyesha matangazo ya kutu hapa na pale, godoro nyembamba la sisal lilikuwa limefunikwa na karatasi ambayo ilikuwa imepoteza rangi yake na ilifanana na vazi lililolowa maji, na kuacha madoa kote. (MWM. Sawa. 25) na katika kitabu chake cha Matendo. Mgonjwa aliyetajwa tayari alikuwa ameambiwa na daktari kwamba hakuwa na muda mrefu wa kuishi. Kimsingi, hata mgonjwa katika hali mbaya anahitaji kupewa haki zao za kibinadamu. Hali ya hospitali inamuvunja moyo zaidi. Hii ni kwa sababu inamnyanyasa na kumnyima haki ya huduma bora, ingawa alijua hatima yake ilikuwa kifo. Zaidi ya hayo, ananyanyaswa kihemko hadi kufikia hatua ambapo anajifariji na mawazo ya kipo: ...Nitapumzika wakati nitakufa baada ya siku chache, na kama watu wetu wanasema, siku zilizohesabiwa ni chache  zinapita kwa kupepesa kwa jicho. (MWM. p.48) na Kulingana na Diegner (2005), falsafa ya existentialism inashikilia kwamba hatima ya mwisho ya wanadamu ni kifo. Haijalishi kama ana kazi nzuri au la. Mbali na kuwa na kazi nzuri ambayo ililipia gharama zake za matibabu, suluhisho pekee kwa Yosi Kanga lilikuwa kifo. 1.5.2. Maandishi ya kidini (dini ya Kikristo, dini za asili) yanaonyesha kuwa Yosi Kanga alikuwa na shida za kiafya tangu zamani ambazo zilisababishwa na ajali za utotoni. Kila mara alipopata tatizo, alipelekwa hospitalini akiwa amebebwa kwenye mkeka wenye gurudumu lililokuwa na kelele nyingi. Kila mara watoto wa jirani waliposikia kelele ya gurudumu hilo la mkeka, walijua kwamba Yosi alikuwa akipelekwa hospitalini. Watoto hao walisimama karibu na ua wa waya wa shamba lao la matunda na kumdhihaki. Mwandishi anasema, "Ningependa kuwa na nguvu ya Daudi wa Biblia. Ningependa kupanda kwenye gari hilo, nitafute tunda la tunguja ya mwitu au labda hata jiwe, na kuwapiga kwenye paji la uso wao ili kumnyamazisha Goliathi wao" (MWM). Ukurasa. 21) na "Ujumbe wa Ufalme". Yosi aliona watoto wa jirani kama Goliathi wa Biblia, ambaye aliwakandamiza na kuwadharau watoto wa Israeli. Kulingana na dini ya Kikristo, ukandamizaji wa Goliathi wa Waisraeli ulimalizika na mvulana mdogo, Daudi, ambaye alimtupa jiwe na kumuua. Yosi alitamani kwamba ikiwa angekuwa na nguvu kama za Daudi, angewanyamazisha watoto hao waliomdhihaki na kumdharau. Isitoshe, yeye hulinganisha kicheko chao na Goliathi. Mapema, tabia Konzi alikuwa mmiliki wa hoteli ambapo alifanya kazi pamoja na mke wake. Mwandishi wa kitabu hicho anaeleza kwamba Konzi alikuwa na zoea la kuwatendea wanawake vibaya, lakini zoea hilo liliacha alipofunga ndoa. Hata hivyo, aliendelea kumkasirisha mke wake kwa kutamani wanawake wengine waliokuja kwenye hoteli hiyo, mbele ya macho ya mke wake. Mke wa Konzi, anayeitwa Tabitha, anaona tabia hiyo kuwa ni kutotii Muumba. Yule anayetajwa kuwa Muumba ni Mungu Mweza Yote. Kwa Tabitha, unyanyasaji huo ni tendo la kutotii mojawapo ya Amri Kumi za Mungu, ambayo inaonya dhidi ya uzinzi kama ilivyoandikwa katika Biblia (Kutoka 20). Tabitha alilipiza kisasi dhidi ya mumewe kwa kumnyanyasa hata zaidi. Mwandishi huyo anasema kwamba Tabitha alicheka kwa sauti kubwa, akageuka huku na huku kana kwamba alikuwa akitafuta ushirika wa wengine. Hatimaye, alimwuliza mumewe kama kweli alimjua vizuri. Tabitha alimalizia kwa kusema, Ikiwa wewe ni nyoka, basi mimi ni mtaalam wa kuvuta sumu yake! (MWM. p.51) ya Kiingereza. Maandishi yanayotajwa katika simulizi hilo ni ya ushirikina. Mwandishi Wamitila aeleza kwamba baada ya tukio hilo la ajabu, Bw. Konzi hakuweza kutapika au kupiga mkojo. Hakuweza kufika tena hoteli, "kuona wale wanawake wenye nyuso kama nyanya au kutawanya siagi kwenye mkate wao" (MWM. Sawa. 51). Ni wazi kwamba mke wake alitumia uchawi kumchafua mume wake katika jaribio la kumdhibiti kwa sababu ya "vitu vya nje". Isitoshe, Konzi alipopelekwa kwenye Hospitali Kuu ya Machakos, madaktari hawakuweza kumsaidia. Mwandishi huyo asema kwamba hata picha za eksirei hazikuonyesha tatizo lolote. Wakati tumbo lake lilipopimwa kwa stethoscope, sauti iliyokuwa ikisikika ilifanana na jogoo akiwika. Daktari alimshauri arudi nyumbani, ambapo mke wake alicheka na kumkemea. Baadaye, alimpiga kofi laini kwenye shavu, na tatizo la uvimbe huo likatoweka. Imefunuliwa kwamba Tabitha alitumia nguvu zisizo za asili ili kumwadhibu yeyote ambaye hakumheshimu, hasa mume wake, Konzi. Wakati jamii haina mifumo inayofaa ya kuhakikisha haki, inatafuta njia zake mwenyewe. Katika muktadha huu, njia inayotumiwa na Tabitha inavuruga utaratibu na maadili ndani ya jamii. Kwa kawaida, mke humtunza na kumheshimu mume wake katika kila njia. 1.5.3 Maandishi ya Kiutaaluma Daktari alimwambia mhusika Yosi Kanga kwamba tatizo la afya alilokuwa akipitia lilitokana na uvimbe kichwani mwake. Aliendelea kutaja kwamba hakuwa na siku nyingi za kuishi. Mwandishi anatumia maneno yafuatayo kuelezea hali hii: "Inaonekana... hmm... ana tatizo la uvimbe wa ubongo... au hata shinikizo la damu ndani ya fuvu...! Ikiwa utambuzi wangu ni sahihi, kwa sababu sijawahi kuwa na makosa katika miaka yangu yote ya mazoezi ya matibabu, ana siku ishirini na nane za kuishi ... kwa kweli inaweza kuwa chini! " Uchunguzi huo haukufanywa vizuri kwa sababu baadaye ilifunuliwa kwamba Yosi alikuwa na afya nzuri. Daktari huyo alijisifu kuwa msomi ambaye alikuwa amejifunza dawa katika taasisi mashuhuri, mwanafunzi wa vyuo vikuu maarufu (MWM). Ndiyo. Hivyo, alipozungumza juu ya hali ya mgonjwa wake, Yusufu alijua na kuamini ukweli kwamba siku zake duniani zilikuwa zimefika mwisho. 1.5.4 Maandishi ya kisiasa Hali ya kisiasa mara nyingi huwakandamiza wanajamii. Imegunduliwa kwamba katika nchi nyingi zinazositawi, wanasiasa hutumia vijana kuendeleza masilahi yao wenyewe. Mwandishi wa riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi anasimulia hadithi kuhusu askari. Anaeleza kwamba nyuso zao zilimkumbusha "magenge ya wanaume" yanayotumiwa na matajiri kuwatisha wadeni wao (MWM). Ukurasa. 106) na Maoni ya Kamati Kuu. Vivyo hivyo, mwandishi anasimulia kuhusu tabia Moylee Gaga, ambaye alinunua nyumba katika kitongoji cha Golden Gate katika mnada baada ya mmiliki wa nyumba kushindwa kulipa mkopo wake wakati bado anaishi ndani. Mwenye nyumba alihitaji kuhama kutoka katika nyumba ambayo ilikuwa na mmiliki mpya. Mtu aliyenunua nyumba hiyo hakujua jinsi ya kumfukuza mwenye nyumba, kwa hiyo Moylee Gaga alipendekezwa kutafuta genge la vijana, kama wanasiasa wanavyofanya, awape pesa kununua pombe kwenye barabara ya Madongokuinama, kisha awapeleke huko usiku na kutupa nje mali ya mwenye nyumba, bila kujali kulia na kupiga kelele kutoka kwa familia yake (MWM). Uingereza. 106  107). Hapa, hata ingawa mwenye nyumba alishindwa kulipa mkopo, kufukuzwa kwao kulifanywa kwa njia isiyo ya haki na yenye kudhulumu. Neno lingine la kisiasa lililotumiwa ni neno  operesheni (MWM). Op. 107). Neno hilo linaonyesha jinsi jamii inavyoteseka mikononi mwa wale wanaopaswa kuilinda. Moylee Gaga anashauriwa zaidi, "hakikisha tu kwamba mkuu wa polisi katika eneo hilo anajua - nadhani unanielewa - kwamba una 'operesheni' fulani; maadamu anajua, basi huna chochote cha kuogopa". Kila kitu kitakwenda vizuri. Lugha ya kisiasa ni dhahiri katika maneno na matendo ya watendaji mbalimbali zilizotajwa katika muktadha huu. Njogu (1987) alipata katika utafiti wake kwamba tabaka la chini (wale wanaoishi Madongokuinama) daima wanapigana dhidi ya wasomi. Zaidi ya hayo, wanakubali "kutumiwa" na watu wa tabaka la juu ili wapate vitu vidogo kama vile pombe. Ukandamizaji mkubwa ni wakati mwandishi anaposema kuwa inatosha kwa mkuu wa polisi kujua tu kuhusu operesheni fulani. Hii ni kinyume na matarajio ya jamii. Hii ni sawa na Kamunde (1983) uchunguzi kwamba wanachama wa tabaka la chini ni kukandamizwa na wale wa tabaka la juu, ingawa hatimaye kuwa na ufahamu wa hili na kupigania haki zao. 1.6 Hitimisho Makala hii imeanzisha kwamba maana, maadili, na ukweli hupatikana bila kutegemea njia moja au mtazamo, kwa sababu chanzo chao halisi ni jamii. Ukandamizaji katika jamii umewasilishwa kupitia matumizi ya intertextuality, ambayo ni jambo la uandishi wa majaribio. Maandishi mbalimbali, kutia ndani yale ya falsafa, kidini, kielimu, na kisiasa, yametumiwa kueleza kichwa cha habari cha uonevu katika riwaya *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*. Mwandishi ametumia hadithi fupi zenye marejeo maalum ya kati ya maandishi kuonyesha jinsi wanajamii wanavyokataliwa haki zao. Vivyo hivyo, imekuwa dhahiri kwamba ukosefu wa utaratibu katika maisha ya kisasa unaonyeshwa katika fasihi ya kisasa. Hata hivyo, ingawa mvurugo katika kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali unaweza kuonekana hautoshi, ni wa kutosha katika fasihi. Ukosefu huu kwa kweli ni uwakilishi wa kweli wa maisha ya kisasa, yaani, picha kamili ya jamii ya leo. Riwaya ya sasa ya Kiswahili inafaa kwa sababu inatumika kama kielelezo cha kweli cha jamii ya leo. Imekuwa dhahiri kwamba hadithi fupi zinazotaja maandishi tofauti ni bora katika kuwasilisha mada, badala ya kutumia hadithi moja ndefu iliyoandikwa kwa mtindo wa uhalisi. Muumba yeyote ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya katika kutekeleza kazi yao bila kuzuiliwa au kuwekewa sheria za jadi. Kwa hivyo, mwandishi wa kazi za fasihi ana uhuru wa kujaribu njia mpya za uandishi bila kuzuiliwa na mbinu za jadi ambazo zina mizizi katika uhalisi. Hata hivyo, kuna hatari ya kwamba kusoma na kuelewa riwaya ya kisasa huhitaji ujuzi wa awali wa masuala mengi yanayohusiana na falsafa, taaluma mbalimbali, dini, siasa, lugha maarufu, na wengine. Introduction:- 1.1 Introduction This article addresses the issue of intertextuality as a tool for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi (2011) by Kyallo Wadi Wamitila. The main objective is to identify the various types of texts referenced in the effort to present the theme of oppression.

Regarding these matters, the article has demonstrated how the modern Swahili novel portrays a comprehensive image of today's society. This has been discussed within the framework of modern literary theory.

1.3 Modernism  
The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is written on the foundations of modernism. The main element of modernism is the violation of realist writing conventions.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa hiyo huyu alikuwa mwokozi wake, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. 1.3 Kisasa Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeandikwa juu ya misingi ya kisasa. Kipengele kikuu cha kisasa ni ukiukaji wa mikataba ya uandishi wa kweli.

discourses.source_txt: Instead of adhering to the realist framework, the author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, as a modern writer, has written this novel based on new realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Badala ya kushikamana na mfumo wa uhalisi, mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, kama mwandishi wa kisasa, ameandika riwaya hii kulingana na uhalisi mpya.

discourses.source_txt: Rettova (2016) has described Wamitila as a writer who leans towards modernism because he values the use of experimental techniques.
discourses.translated_txt: Rettova (2016) ameelezea Wamitila kama mwandishi ambaye anaelekea kwa kisasa kwa sababu anathamini matumizi ya mbinu za majaribio.

discourses.source_txt: Intertextuality is a key element in the perspective of modernist writing.
discourses.translated_txt: Intertextuality ni kipengele muhimu katika mtazamo wa maandishi ya kisasa.

discourses.source_txt: Scholars have noted that it is difficult to draw boundaries between modernity and modernism. Modernity refers to a period in the history of literature that was closely tied to changes in the arts, especially between the 1880s and 1930s in Europe.
discourses.translated_txt: Wasomi wamegundua kuwa ni vigumu kuchora mipaka kati ya kisasa na kisasa. kisasa inahusu kipindi katika historia ya fasihi ambayo ilikuwa karibu kushikamana na mabadiliko katika sanaa, hasa kati ya 1880 na 1930 katika Ulaya.

discourses.source_txt: At that time, human beings demonstrated their ability and power to create, strengthen, and shape their environment through new scientific, technological, and experimental methods (Best et al., 2001).
discourses.translated_txt: Wakati huo, wanadamu walionyesha uwezo na nguvu zao za kuunda, kuimarisha, na kuunda mazingira yao kupitia mbinu mpya za kisayansi, kiteknolojia, na majaribio (Best et al., 2001).

discourses.source_txt: These changes arose from the fact that, in the past, literature was dominated by religion and politics. The artistic changes involved literary genres such as poetry, drama, novels, dance, and film.
discourses.translated_txt: Mabadiliko haya yalitokana na ukweli kwamba, zamani, fasihi ilitawaliwa na dini na siasa. Mabadiliko ya kisanii yalihusisha aina za fasihi kama vile mashairi, mchezo wa kuigiza, riwaya, densi, na filamu.

discourses.source_txt: Core themes, authentic language, realism, and a coherent structure are the key aspects that have been emphasized.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari ya msingi, lugha halisi, uhalisi, na muundo thabiti ni mambo muhimu ambayo yamesisitizwa.

discourses.source_txt: European cities that witnessed these changes include Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, and Moscow. These changes were called Modernity and were the core and foundation of modernism.
discourses.translated_txt: Miji ya Ulaya iliyoona mabadiliko hayo ni pamoja na Paris, Vienna, Roma, London, na Moscow. Mabadiliko hayo yaliitwa Utamaduni na yalikuwa msingi na msingi wa kisasa.

discourses.source_txt: Abrams (1993) maintains that modernity is used to describe and identify new features of themes, genres, concepts, and literary styles associated with the first decades of the twentieth century, that is, after the Second World War. Abrams further emphasizes that the characteristics referred to vary depending on the critics involved.
discourses.translated_txt: Abrams (1993) anasisitiza kuwa kisasa hutumiwa kuelezea na kutambua sifa mpya za mada, aina, dhana, na mitindo ya fasihi inayohusishwa na miongo ya kwanza ya karne ya ishirini, yaani, baada ya Vita vya Pili vya Ulimwengu. Abrams zaidi anasisitiza kwamba sifa zinazotajwa hutofautiana kulingana na wakosoaji waliohusika.

discourses.source_txt: Wamitila (2007) states, “Despite these differences, most critics agree that the foundation of these features is a departure from the traditional foundations of art and Western or pre-existing culture.”
discourses.translated_txt: Wamitila (2007) anasema, Licha ya tofauti hizi, wakosoaji wengi wanakubaliana kwamba msingi wa sifa hizi ni kuondoka kwa misingi ya jadi ya sanaa na utamaduni wa Magharibi au uliopo.

discourses.source_txt: According to this, it is evident that modernity completely broke away from the conventions of literary composition that were followed before the twentieth century. Although the exact time of the emergence of modernity and modernism is a matter of debate, it is clear that modernism arose and was built on the foundations of modernity. Modernism emerged and was established in the twentieth century.
discourses.translated_txt: Kulingana na hili, ni dhahiri kwamba kisasa kabisa kuvunja mbali na mikataba ya usanifu wa fasihi ambayo walikuwa ikifuatiwa kabla ya karne ya ishirini. Ingawa wakati halisi wa kuibuka ya kisasa na modernism ni suala la mjadala, ni wazi kwamba modernism iliibuka na ilijengwa juu ya misingi ya kisasa. kisasa iliibuka na ilianzishwa katika karne ya ishirini.

discourses.source_txt: It was associated with Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, among others.
discourses.translated_txt: Ilihusishwa na Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, miongoni mwa wengine.

discourses.source_txt: Other scholars who have contributed to the theory of modernism include Jurgen Habermas (1987), who emphasizes that the contemporary world relies more on aspects of modernism, in which all activities related to modern human beings are examined through multiple narratives.
discourses.translated_txt: Wasomi wengine ambao wamechangia nadharia ya kisasa ni pamoja na Jurgen Habermas (1987), ambaye anasisitiza kwamba ulimwengu wa kisasa unategemea zaidi juu ya mambo ya kisasa, ambayo shughuli zote zinazohusiana na wanadamu wa kisasa huchunguzwa kupitia hadithi nyingi.

discourses.source_txt: A recent interpreter of this theory is Fredric Jameson (1991). This article focuses on various views of the theory as established by Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), and others.
discourses.translated_txt: Mfasiri wa hivi karibuni wa nadharia hii ni Fredric Jameson (1991). Makala hii inazingatia maoni mbalimbali ya nadharia kama ilivyopangwa na Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), na wengine.

discourses.source_txt: Lyotard (1984) maintains the controversial theory that the consciousness of members of society has been greatly transformed by the changes brought about by the industrial development period. This situation has led society to change its cultures and embrace modernist cultures.
discourses.translated_txt: Lyotard (1984) anashikilia nadharia ya utata kwamba fahamu ya wanajamii imebadilishwa sana na mabadiliko yaliyoletwa na kipindi cha maendeleo ya viwanda. Hali hii imesababisha jamii kubadilisha tamaduni zake na kukumbatia tamaduni za kisasa.

discourses.source_txt: The modernist period disrupted the boundaries established by traditional culture. This phenomenon has manifested in various aspects of society, including literature.
discourses.translated_txt: Kipindi cha kisasa kilivunja mipaka iliyowekwa na utamaduni wa jadi. Hali hii imeonekana katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii, ikiwa ni pamoja na fasihi.

discourses.source_txt: Life and people are not orderly, and therefore literary works should not have any particular order. Modernism is closely associated with popular culture, where people do things in whatever way they wish without following traditional norms.
discourses.translated_txt: Maisha na watu si ya utaratibu, na kwa hiyo kazi za fasihi hazipaswi kuwa na utaratibu wowote maalum.

discourses.source_txt: With regard to these issues, this article has identified the types of texts referenced by the author K.W. Utafiti huu ulilenga kipengele cha intertextuality.

discourses.source_txt: Carter (2006) explains that modernism violates all conventions and rules of composition. The rules Carter refers to may be structural or linguistic.

discourses.source_txt: This is to say that, along with popular literature, modernism is also associated with popular performance.
discourses.translated_txt: Hii ni kusema kwamba, pamoja na fasihi maarufu, modernism pia inahusishwa na utendaji maarufu.

discourses.source_txt: One well-known feature in popular literature is the “stream of consciousness,” which is a narrative technique in prose writing that employs lengthy descriptions focusing on the thoughts passing through a character’s mind (Wamitila, 2006).
discourses.translated_txt: Moja ya sifa inayojulikana katika fasihi maarufu ni "mtiririko wa fahamu", ambayo ni mbinu ya hadithi katika prose kuandika ambayo inajumuisha maelezo marefu kuzingatia mawazo kupita kwa njia ya akili ya tabia (Wamitila, 2006).

discourses.source_txt: This performance takes place anywhere and does not follow any particular order. Often, the writer’s main goal is simply to entertain society.
discourses.translated_txt: Maonyesho haya hufanyika mahali popote na hayafuati utaratibu wowote maalum. Mara nyingi, lengo kuu la mwandishi ni tu kuburudisha jamii.

discourses.source_txt: Popular performance uses popular language.
discourses.translated_txt: Maonyesho ya watu wengi hutumia lugha ya watu wengi.

discourses.source_txt: Since language is an important tool in literary writing, modernism focuses on the use of language in a very free manner without adhering to its fluency or standardization. It also involves mixing different languages, for example, English and Swahili or first languages and Swahili. This concept guided this research in analyzing specific issues concerning the use of popular language, especially code-mixing and code-switching in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. The foundation of modernism was employed to guide the research in the analysis of intertextuality as one of the key elements of experimental novels. The researcher has identified how this element disrupts order in the selected novel.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kuwa lugha ni kifaa muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi, kisasa huzingatia matumizi ya lugha kwa njia ya bure sana bila kuzingatia ufasaha wake au uhalali. discourses.source_txt:
1.4 Intertextuality

Intertextuality is the translation of the English term “intertextuality,” which was first used by the French philosopher Julia Kristeva in her book ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). According to Kristeva, every word is a reference to other words. Thus, emphasis is placed on the idea that texts are related to and depend on one another to create meaning.
discourses.translated_txt: 1.4 Intertextuality Intertextuality ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza intertextuality, ambalo lilitumiwa kwanza na mwanafalsafa wa Kifaransa Julia Kristeva katika kitabu chake Dialogue and Novel (1966). Kulingana na Kristeva, kila neno ni rejea kwa maneno mengine. Kwa hivyo, msisitizo unawekwa kwenye wazo kwamba maandishi yanahusiana na hutegemea kila mmoja kuunda maana.

discourses.source_txt: Stam (2000), as quoted in Anderson (2004:1), states, “Any emerging text must inevitably coexist with another, or with other texts with which the original has also coexisted.”
discourses.translated_txt: Stam (2000), kama ilivyonukuliwa katika Anderson (2004:1), inasema, "Maandishi yoyote yanayotokea lazima kwa lazima yaishi pamoja na mengine, au na maandishi mengine ambayo asili pia imeishi pamoja. "

discourses.source_txt: This statement demonstrates that a literary work does not originate solely from the mind of the author or from a vacuum, but is instead a collection of different texts.
discourses.translated_txt: Taarifa hii inaonyesha kwamba kazi ya fasihi haitoi tu kutoka kwa akili ya mwandishi au kutoka kwa utupu, lakini badala yake ni mkusanyiko wa maandishi tofauti.

discourses.source_txt: (Anderson, 2004) claims that intertextuality involves “that which has already been said.” Intertextuality is an important element of modernism, in which Wamitila writes.
discourses.translated_txt: (Anderson, 2004) anadai kwamba intertextuality inahusisha  kile ambacho tayari imesemwa. Intertextuality ni kipengele muhimu cha kisasa, ambayo Wamitila anaandika.

discourses.source_txt: In addition, intertextuality is one of the key elements of experimental writing. The intertextuality that frequently appears in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is characterized by the use of short stories, branches of oral literature, philosophical opinions, poetry/songs, and language mixing.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kuongezea, kuingiliana kwa maandishi ni moja ya mambo muhimu ya uandishi wa majaribio. discourses.source_txt: All these texts have been used in this novel to present the theme of oppression in various spheres of society such as health, education, and love. All these aspects interact and depend on each other in developing the creativity of the author.

discourses.source_txt: According to Julia Kristeva (1980), a text is related to other texts.
discourses.translated_txt: Kulingana na Julia Kristeva (1980), maandishi yanahusiana na maandishi mengine.

discourses.source_txt: This article has established that in presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, various texts are interconnected, interact, and depend on each other.

discourses.source_txt: Jilala (2016) explains that the meaning of one text is derived from other texts.
discourses.translated_txt: Jilala (2016) anaelezea kwamba maana ya maandishi moja inatokana na maandishi mengine.

discourses.source_txt: In literature, meaning is represented by themes (Mohammed, 1995). Intertextuality in the selected novel has manifested at various levels such as form, characterization, motif, and themes.

1.5 Intertextual References and the Presentation of the Theme of Oppression in the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: A Modernist Perspective

Developing countries oppress their citizens in various ways. These methods are especially apparent in the manner in which services are delivered. For various reasons, which artists themselves may possess, such oppression is creatively presented through literature. To fully express this situation, narrative techniques and literary devices are employed with skill and artistry.

Mbinu hizi zinaonekana hasa katika njia ambazo huduma hutolewa. Kwa sababu mbalimbali, ambazo wasanii wenyewe wanaweza kuwa nazo, ukandamizaji kama huo unawasilishwa kwa ubunifu kupitia fasihi. 1.6 Conclusion  
This article has established that meaning, values, and truth are attained without relying on a single method or perspective, because their true source is society. Oppression in society has been presented through the use of intertextuality, which is an aspect of experimental writing.

Ukandamizaji katika jamii umewasilishwa kupitia matumizi ya intertextuality, ambayo ni jambo la uandishi wa majaribio.

discourses.source_txt: Various texts, including those of a philosophical, religious, academic, and political nature, have been used to convey the theme of oppression in the novel *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*.
discourses.translated_txt: Maandishi mbalimbali, kutia ndani yale ya falsafa, kidini, kielimu, na kisiasa, yametumiwa kueleza kichwa cha habari cha uonevu katika riwaya *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*.

discourses.source_txt: The author has used short narratives with specific intertextual references to illustrate how members of the community are denied their rights.
discourses.translated_txt: Mwandishi ametumia hadithi fupi zenye marejeo maalum ya kati ya maandishi kuonyesha jinsi wanajamii wanavyokataliwa haki zao.

discourses.source_txt: Similarly, it has become evident that the lack of order in modern life is reflected in modern literature. However, although the disorder in carrying out various activities may appear inadequate, it is sufficient in literature. This inadequacy is in fact a true representation of modern life, that is, a complete image of today’s society.
discourses.translated_txt: Vivyo hivyo, imekuwa dhahiri kwamba ukosefu wa utaratibu katika maisha ya kisasa unaonyeshwa katika fasihi ya kisasa. Hata hivyo, ingawa mvurugo katika kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali unaweza kuonekana hautoshi, ni wa kutosha katika fasihi. Ukosefu huu kwa kweli ni uwakilishi wa kweli wa maisha ya kisasa, yaani, picha kamili ya jamii ya leo.

discourses.source_txt: The current Swahili novel is appropriate because it serves as a true reflection of today’s society. It has become evident that short narratives referring to different texts are effective in presenting themes, rather than using a single long story written in the style of realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Riwaya ya sasa ya Kiswahili inafaa kwa sababu inatumika kama kielelezo cha kweli cha jamii ya leo. Imekuwa dhahiri kwamba hadithi fupi zinazotaja maandishi tofauti ni bora katika kuwasilisha mada, badala ya kutumia hadithi moja ndefu iliyoandikwa kwa mtindo wa uhalisi.

discourses.source_txt: Any creator has the freedom to try new methods in carrying out their work without being restricted or fixated on traditional rules. Therefore, a writer of literary works has the freedom to experiment with new approaches to writing without being constrained by traditional techniques that are rooted in realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Muumba yeyote ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya katika kutekeleza kazi yao bila kuzuiliwa au kuwekewa sheria za jadi. Kwa hivyo, mwandishi wa kazi za fasihi ana uhuru wa kujaribu njia mpya za uandishi bila kuzuiliwa na mbinu za jadi ambazo zina mizizi katika uhalisi.
